name: Yandex data center (Grabtsevo industrial park)
notes: Yandex fourth and most powerful DC in Russia at Grabtsevo industrial park near Kaluga; design area ~130,000 m2 and design capacity 63 MW; construction started Sept 2022 and reported ongoing per plan into 2025-2026; Yandex jobs page lists active Kaluga DC.

name: Key Point Krasnodar data center (Tier III)
notes: Tier III data center in Krasnodar under design and turnkey construction by Svobodnye Tekhnologii Inzhiniring (project window 2024-2028); listed as in-process on project page and in Key Point regional network.

name: Rostelecom legacy data center (Krasnodar)
notes: Trade-press reference (2012) to existing Rostelecom data centers in Krasnodar and Stavropol as part of the South cluster; legacy facility, current status unverified.

name: RTK-DC Khabarovsk data center
notes: Planned RTK-DC data center in Khabarovsk Krai: 4 machine halls, 440 rack places, 4 MW supplied power; design to start 2025, commissioning planned Q3 2027.

name: Intelion modular data center for energy-intensive computing (Khakassia)
notes: Modular data center for energy-intensive (mining/HPC) computing in Khakassia; reported as the largest in the region at 48 MW total, final stage under completion as of mid-2025; mining-oriented, cloud/AI conversion not confirmed.

name: RusHydro corporate data center at Sayano-Shushenskaya HPP site
notes: Agreement between Khakassia government and RusHydro on joint implementation of a corporate data center at the Sayano-Shushenskaya HPP site (largest hydro station); announced June 2026.

name: DATA-CENTER 114 (TsOD114, Zelenets industrial park)
notes: Autonomous energy-independent data center in Zelenets industrial park, Komi Republic: 114 MW powered by local gas-piston generation; construction started Nov 2025; promoted as Russia's largest gas-powered data center, primarily mining/HPC workloads.

name: Komi republic 15-data-center program
notes: Sept 2024 agreement to build 15 data centers in Komi for ~35 bln RUB; first center targeted by end-2024 per TASS (Aug 2023); program-level announcement, individual sites not yet verified.

name: Data processing center new stage (Segezha district)
notes: Regional press reports investment project for a new stage of a data processing center in Segezha district, Karelia; operator and capacity not disclosed.
